api: heif_context_read_from_file(local MP4 path); heif_context_number_of_sequence_tracks; heif_context_get_track; heif_track_get_image_resolution
coverage: LLVM source coverage in the pinned libheif native ISO BMFF box and sequence-track parser (libheif/), built as a static codec-free libheif and called through heif_context_read_from_file on a local file from a C++17 byte-input harness
parser_family: libheif native ISO BMFF image-sequence and MP4 parser; the C call site (adapters/c/mp4/libheif) uses the same libheif C API and parser, so they are one parser family. libheif reads MP4 as an image sequence: it parses moov/trak boxes and visual sample entries, and skips audio tracks as an unsupported handler type
